title: odd-container
description: A content measure and an inline-size container: container queries and layout recipe conditions inside it resolve against its width, not the viewport's. `measure="constrained"` (the default) centres it with the theme's `layout.measure` as its maximum inline size; `fluid` fills the space. Insets are the page's: put an `.odd-box` inside or around it.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

measure.description: Constrained: centred, at most the measure wide. Fluid: the full width.
